title: The Monkey and the Crocodile
moral: Think wisely in difficult situations to solve problems.

scenes.summary: A friendly monkey lives on a tree and meets a crocodile.
scenes.text:
The Monkey and the Crocodile

Once upon a time, a clever monkey lived on a fruit tree by a river.

The tree had sweet, juicy fruits.

One day, a crocodile came swimming by.

“Hello!” said the monkey kindly.

“Would you like some fruit?”

The crocodile smiled.

“Thank you!” he said.

Soon, they became good friends.

story:
The Monkey and the Crocodile

Once upon a time, a clever monkey lived on a fruit tree by a river.

The tree had sweet, juicy fruits.

One day, a crocodile came swimming by.

“Hello!” said the monkey kindly.

“Would you like some fruit?”

The crocodile smiled.

“Thank you!” he said.

Soon, they became good friends.

One day, the crocodile took some fruits home for his wife.

“These are delicious!” she said.

“If the fruits are so sweet, the monkey’s heart must be sweeter!”

She said,

“Bring me the monkey’s heart.”

The crocodile was shocked.

“But he is my friend,” he said.

Still, he agreed sadly.

The next day, the crocodile went to the monkey.

“My friend,” he said,

“come visit my home.”

The monkey agreed and climbed onto his back.

As they swam, the crocodile felt nervous.

Finally, he said,

“I must tell you something… my wife wants your heart.”

The monkey was scared but stayed calm.

“Oh dear!” he said.

“I left my heart on the tree!”

“Let’s go back and get it.”

The crocodile believed him.

“Alright,” he said.

And turned back toward the tree.

As soon as they reached the tree, the monkey jumped up quickly.

“You foolish crocodile!” he said.

“Who leaves their heart behind?”

“You tried to trick me, but I was smarter.”

The crocodile felt ashamed.

He swam away sadly.

The monkey stayed safe on his tree.

Think wisely in difficult situations to solve problems.

The End
